checks.summary: A valid password hash is required; the development login is not rollout authentication.
An explicitly configured session signing secret is required.
Unjournaled native worker tools must remain disabled.
Worker/background profile roots must be separate from each other and the desktop profile; credentials are not inspected.
The tested runtime package must match the pinned version.
Build the production companion before starting the API.
Schema and foreign keys must match the current code; migration is an explicit deployment step.

external_gates.summary: Verify an account-enforced cutoff; a local budget flag is not evidence.
Run end-to-end wake/audio/provider acceptance; fixture and system-gesture evidence do not pass this gate.
Physical acoustics, protected/locked context, OEM persistence and real-phone delivery remain deferred.
The verified route uses API authentication; separately authorize and test a Jarvis subscription profile if desired.
Explicitly approve the deployment transport, device and progressive enablement; no flags are changed here.
A database-only fixture restore is not a full production backup: retain context blobs, artifacts, workspaces and native profiles together after confirmed writer stop.

scope: Read-only local preparation; not full rollout acceptance or authorization
